prompts.backdrop: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished wide raster background artwork for a real application skin titled 晴空信笺, meaning Clear Sky Letters. Flat artwork fills the whole canvas edge to edge. No UI mockup, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no gradients that become dark, no photographic desk, no frame.
